name: Amazon DFW7 Fulfillment Center Fort Worth TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance on the west drive off Westport Pkwy: guard booth straddling the lanes with yellow barrier arms and bollards, confirmed in Street View (2023-02). Yellow-striped lane dividers and red-curbed median.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small staffed gatehouse structure sitting between the inbound/outbound lanes at the west gate, ~1-2 vehicle footprint, distinct from the main building.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Entry drive runs ~120m+ from the Westport Pkwy stop bar south to the gate, easily holding 3+ trucks before the booth.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound from the multi-lane gate apron in Street View; exact split between in/out lanes not fully resolvable overhead.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with red-curbed median and unused paved width — room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: West wall is lined with a near-continuous row of dock doors for the building's full ~600m length; 50+ band is firm, point estimate ~140 is approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: West apron holds dozens of drop trailers (no tractor) plus a south van/trailer lot; well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: AllianceTexas logistics park on the edge of Fort Worth/Haslet — large industrial setting surrounded by warehouses and open land rather than dense metro fabric; judged Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Large modern Amazon FC in an active industrial park near Alliance Airport; cellular coverage almost certainly fine — false.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer staging along the west apron and south lot, separate from active dock backing.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; site is truck/air-served (adjacent Perot Field Alliance Airport).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 78.8 ac from the traced perimeter incl. yard and parking; published figure ~68 ac for the building parcel.

citations.claim: TDLR-registered active renovation project 'EOL Building Refresh 2024 - DFW7', 700 Westport Pkwy, interior refresh of existing operating FC, 2/1/2025-8/31/2025 — proves active operation in 2025, not a canceled shell
Amazon actively hiring in Fort Worth (AllianceTexas FC cluster, Westport Pkwy)

verification.rationale: 2025 TDLR refresh permit on exact 700 Westport Pkwy building confirms active FC operation; 2022 DFW cancellations never named this address. Note: building at Fort Worth/Haslet line (AllianceTexas), some directories say Haslet 76177.
